# Journalism Geo v1.0.24

> Useful TypeScript functions for journalism projects. This library focuses on wrangling geospatial data.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.24/README.md): Installation, examples and usage.

## API
- [distance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.24/docs/functions/distance.md): distance function
- [geoTo3D](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.24/docs/functions/geoTo3D.md): geoTo3D function
- [geoToBlender](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.24/docs/functions/geoToBlender.md): geoToBlender function
- [geoToBlenderPoint](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.24/docs/functions/geoToBlenderPoint.md): geoToBlenderPoint function
- [getClosest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.24/docs/functions/getClosest.md): getClosest function
- [getGeoTiffDetails](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.24/docs/functions/getGeoTiffDetails.md): getGeoTiffDetails function
- [getGeoTiffValues](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.24/docs/functions/getGeoTiffValues.md): getGeoTiffValues function
- [styledLayerDescriptor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.24/docs/functions/styledLayerDescriptor.md): styledLayerDescriptor function
